description: This file contains unit tests for the AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzer, verifying that it correctly enforces usage rules of the [AlwaysInterleave] attribute in Orleans grain interface and implementation methods.

classes.name: AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Test class for the AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzer, containing various test cases to validate correct analyzer behavior.

methods.name: GetDiagnosticsAsync
methods.description: Overrides base method to get diagnostics for a given source, adding 'Orleans.Concurrency' to extra usings.

methods.name: AlwaysInterleave_Analyzer_NoWarningsIfAttributeIsNotUsed
methods.description: Test to verify no diagnostics are reported when [AlwaysInterleave] attribute is absent.

methods.name: AlwaysInterleave_Analyzer_NoWarningsIfAttributeIsUsedOnInterface
methods.description: Test to verify no diagnostics are reported when [AlwaysInterleave] is correctly used on an interface method.

methods.name: AlwaysInterleave_Analyzer_WarningIfAttributeisUsedOnGrainClass
methods.description: Test to verify that an error diagnostic is reported when [AlwaysInterleave] is used on a class method instead of interface method.
